title: Corner lot subdivision: porch, balcony or verandah setback to the original secondary street
text: C3.3.2 Notwithstanding C3.3.1, the following reductions are permitted: iii. in areas coded R15 or higher, the street setback, may be reduced to 2.5m, or 1.5m to a porch, balcony, verandah or the equivalent, where a single house results from a subdivision of an original corner lot and has its frontage to the original secondary street.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Porch limb of C3.3.2(iii); same single-house wording issue (register ch3-050). Uses fact building.porch_street_setback_m.

verified.note: Wording confirmed on p31: the grouped dwellings chapter still says 'where a single house results from a subdivision of an original corner lot'. The page does not say whether a grouped dwelling qualifies.
